description_en: Modifies the configuration of an ACK cluster
description_zh: 您可以调用ModifyCluster接口修改ACK集群的配置
name: ModifyCluster

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The access control list for the registered cluster API Server SLB
parameters.help_zh: 注册集群 API Server SLB 访问控制列表
parameters.name: access_control_list

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite or append the SAN configuration. Valid values:
overwrite: overwrites the existing configuration.
append: appends to the existing configuration
fields.help_zh:
覆盖或追加 SAN 配置。取值：
overwrite: 覆盖。
append: 追加
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The SAN list
fields.help_zh: SAN 列表
fields.name: subject_alternative_names

parameters.help_en:
The custom API Server certificate Subject Alternative Name (SAN). This parameter adds custom IP addresses or domain names to the SAN field of the cluster API Server certificate for client access control.

Only managed clusters support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
自定义API Server证书SAN（Subject Alternative Name）。
用于在集群API Server服务端证书的SAN字段中添加自定义的IP或域名，以实现对客户端的访问控制。

仅托管版集群支持配置该参数
parameters.name: api_server_custom_cert_sans

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether an Elastic IP Address (EIP) is attached to the cluster for public network access to the API server. Valid values:

`true`: An EIP is attached to the cluster.
`false`: No EIP is attached to the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
集群是否绑定EIP，用于公网访问API Server。取值：

`true`：集群绑定EIP。
`false`：集群不绑定EIP
parameters.name: api_server_eip

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the EIP attached to the cluster API Server. This parameter takes effect only when `api_server_eip` is set to `true`
parameters.help_zh: 集群API Server绑定的EIP实例ID，仅当`api_server_eip`取值为`true`时生效
parameters.name: api_server_eip_id

parameters.help_en: The client token
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The custom cluster name. The name can contain digits, Chinese characters, letters, and hyphens (-). It must be 1 to 63 characters in length and cannot start with a hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh: 自定义集群名称。由数字、汉字、英文字符或短划线（-）组成，长度范围1~63个字符，且不能以短划线（-）开头
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en:
The cluster specification when `cluster_type` is set to `ManagedKubernetes` and `profile` is configured. Valid values:

`ack.pro.small`: Pro
`ack.pro.xlarge`: Pro XL
`ack.pro.2xlarge`: Pro 2XL
`ack.pro.4xlarge`: Pro 4XL (contact customer service to be added to the whitelist)

Pro XL, Pro 2XL, and Pro 4XL are three tiers provided by <props="china">ACK Pro Provisioned Control Plane (https://help.aliyun.com/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/user-guide/ack-pro-provisioned-control-plane)</props><props="intl">ACK Pro Provisioned Control Plane (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/user-guide/ack-pro-provisioned-control-plane)</props>. By pre-allocating and dedicating control plane resources, these tiers ensure that API concurrency and pod scheduling capabilities remain at a consistently high level. They are suitable for AI training and inference, ultra-large-scale clusters, and mission-critical workloads.

For information about the cluster management fees for Pro and provisioned control plane editions, see <props="china">Cluster management fees (https://help.aliyun.com/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/product-overview/cluster-management-fee)</props><props="intl">Cluster management fees (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/product-overview/cluster-management-fee)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
选择`cluster_type`为`ManagedKubernetes`并配置`profile`时，集群的规格。取值：

`ack.pro.small`：Pro版
`ack.pro.xlarge`：Pro XL
`ack.pro.2xlarge`：Pro 2XL
`ack.pro.4xlarge`: Pro 4XL （需联系客服开通白名单）

Pro XL、Pro 2XL、Pro 4XL为<props="china">ACK Pro 预设控制面 (https://help.aliyun.com/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/user-guide/ack-pro-provisioned-control-plane)</props><props="intl">ACK Pro 预设控制面 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/user-guide/ack-pro-provisioned-control-plane)</props>提供的三个档位，通过预先分配并固化控制面资源，确保 API 并发与 Pod 调度能力始终处于确定的高水平状态，适用于 AI 训练推理、超大规模集群及关键任务型业务。

Pro版及预设控制面版本的集群管理费用请参见<props="china">集群管理费用 (https://help.aliyun.com/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/product-overview/cluster-management-fee)</props><props="intl">集群管理费用 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/ack/ack-managed-and-ack-dedicated/product-overview/cluster-management-fee)</props>
parameters.name: cluster_spec

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for control plane node instances. This parameter takes effect only when `charge_type` is set to `PrePaid`. Valid values:

`true`: Enables auto-renewal.
`false`: Disables auto-renewal.

Default value: `false`
fields.help_zh:
控制面节点实例是否开启自动续费，当`charge_type`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效。取值：

`true`：自动续费。
`false`：不自动续费。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration for each renewal cycle of control plane node instances.

Valid values: {1, 2, 3, 6, 12}. Unit: months.

Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
控制面节点实例单次自动续费的续费时长。

取值范围：{1, 2, 3, 6, 12}，单位：月。

默认值：1
fields.name: auto_renew_period

fields.help_en:
The billing method for control plane node instances. Valid values:

`PrePaid`: subscription.
`PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go.

Default value: `PostPaid`
fields.help_zh:
控制面节点实例付费类型，取值：

`PrePaid`：包年包月。
`PostPaid`：按量付费。

默认值：`PostPaid`
fields.name: charge_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to install the CloudMonitor agent on control plane nodes. Valid values:

`true`: Installs the CloudMonitor agent.
`false`: Does not install the CloudMonitor agent
fields.help_zh:
控制面节点是否安装云监控插件。取值：

`true`：安装云监控插件。
`false`：不安装云监控插件
fields.name: cloud_monitor_flags

fields.help_en:
The node CPU management policy. The following policies are supported for clusters running version 1.12.6 or later:

`static`: Allows pods with certain resource characteristics on the node to be granted enhanced CPU affinity and exclusivity.
`none`: Uses the existing default CPU affinity scheme.

Default value: `none`
fields.help_zh:
节点CPU管理策略。当集群版本在1.12.6及以上时支持以下两种策略：

`static`：允许为节点上具有某些资源特征Pod增强其CPU亲和性和独占性。
`none`：表示启用现有的默认CPU亲和性方案。

默认值：`none`
fields.name: cpu_policy

fields.help_en: The deployment set ID
fields.help_zh: 部署集ID
fields.name: deploymentset_id

fields.help_en: The custom image ID. Specify this parameter when using a custom image
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像ID。自定义镜像时指定
fields.name: image_id

fields.help_en:
The operating system image type. Valid values:

`AliyunLinux3`: Alinux3 image.
`Custom`: custom image
fields.help_zh:
操作系统镜像类型，取值范围：

`AliyunLinux3`：Alinux3镜像。
`Custom`： 自定义镜像
fields.name: image_type

fields.help_en: The instance types. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
fields.help_zh: 实例规格。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
fields.name: instance_types

fields.help_en: The key pair name. Mutually exclusive with `login_password`
fields.help_zh: 密钥对名称，和`login_password`二选一
fields.name: key_pair

fields.help_en: The SSH logon password. Mutually exclusive with `key_pair`. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. To use password-based logon, specify this parameter during scale-out
fields.help_zh: SSH登录密码，和`key_pair `二选一。密码规则为8~30个字符，且至少同时包含三项（大小写字母、数字和特殊符号）。如需要使用密码登录，需在扩容时指定
fields.name: login_password

fields.help_en:
The node service port range. Available port range: [30000, 65535].

Default value: 30000-32767
fields.name: node_port_range

fields.help_en:
The subscription duration for control plane node instances. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `charge_type` is set to `PrePaid`.

When `period_unit=Month`, valid values are {1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60}
fields.help_zh:
控制面节点实例包年包月时长，当`charge_type`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效且为必选值。

当`period_unit=Month`时，取值范围：{1, 2 , 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60}
fields.name: period

fields.help_en:
The billing cycle unit for control plane node instances. This parameter takes effect only when `charge_type` is set to `PrePaid`.

`Month`: The billing cycle is measured in months. Currently, only months are supported
fields.help_zh:
控制面节点实例付费周期，当`charge_type`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效。

`Month`：以月为计时单位，当前只支持以月为单位
fields.name: period_unit

fields.help_en:
The container runtime name. Valid values:

`containerd`: Recommended. Supported by all cluster versions.

Default value: containerd
fields.help_zh:
容器运行时名称，取值范围：

`containerd`：推荐使用，支持所有集群版本。

默认值：containerd
fields.name: runtime

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Alibaba Cloud OS security hardening. Valid values:

`true`: Enables Alibaba Cloud OS security hardening.
`false`: Disables Alibaba Cloud OS security hardening.

Default value: `false`
fields.help_zh:
阿里云OS安全加固。取值：

`true`：开启阿里云OS安全加固。
`false`：不开启阿里云OS安全加固。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: security_hardening_os

fields.help_en: The number of control plane nodes. To scale out the control plane of a dedicated cluster, set this parameter to the target number of control plane nodes, which must be greater than the current number
fields.help_zh: 控制面节点数量。如需扩容专有版控制面，该参数为目标控制面节点数，需大于当前控制面节点数量
fields.name: size

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable MLPS 2.0 security hardening. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196148.html.

Valid values:
`true`: Enables MLPS 2.0 security hardening.
`false`: Disables MLPS 2.0 security hardening.

Default value: `false`
fields.help_zh:
等保加固。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196148.html。

取值：
`true`：开启等保加固。
`false`：不开启等保加固。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: soc_enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable burst (performance burst) for the node system cloud disk. Valid values:
`true`: Enabled.
`false`: Disabled.

This parameter is supported only when `system_disk_category` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.help_zh:
节点系统盘是否开启Burst（性能突发）。 取值：
`true`：是。
`false`：否。

当`system_disk_category `取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.name: system_disk_bursting_enabled

fields.help_en:
The node system cloud disk type. Valid values:
`cloud_efficiency`: ultra cloud disk.
`cloud_ssd`: standard SSD.
`cloud_essd`: Enterprise SSD (ESSD).
`cloud_auto`: ESSD AutoPL cloud disk.
`cloud_essd_entry`: ESSD Entry cloud disk
fields.help_zh:
节点系统盘类型，取值：
`cloud_efficiency`：高效云盘。
`cloud_ssd`：SSD云盘。
`cloud_essd`：ESSD云盘。
`cloud_auto`：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
`cloud_essd_entry`：ESSD Entry 云盘
fields.name: system_disk_category

fields.help_en: The performance level of the node system cloud disk. This parameter takes effect only for ESSD cloud disks. The performance level varies based on the cloud disk size. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
fields.help_zh: 节点系统盘磁盘性能等级， 仅对ESSD磁盘生效。磁盘性能等级和磁盘大小有关。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
fields.name: system_disk_performance_level

fields.help_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS for the node system cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1000 × capacity - baseline performance}. Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 × capacity, 50000}.

This parameter is supported only when `system_disk_category` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.help_zh:
节点系统盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000\容量-基准性能}。 基准性能=min{1,800+50\容量, 50000}。

当`system_disk_category`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
fields.name: system_disk_provisioned_iops

fields.help_en: The node system cloud disk size. Valid values: [40, 500]. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 节点系统盘大小，取值范围[40,500]，单位：GiB
fields.name: system_disk_size

fields.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy applied to the node system cloud disk
fields.help_zh: 节点系统盘采用的自动快照策略ID
fields.name: system_disk_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster control plane configuration
parameters.help_zh: 专有版集群控制面配置
parameters.name: control_plane_config

fields.help_en: The VPCs where the internal domain name resolution takes effect
fields.help_zh: 集群内部域名记录解析生效的 VPC
fields.name: bind_vpcs

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable internal domain name access for the cluster. Valid values:
true: Enables internal domain name access. Node-side components (kubelet, kube-proxy) access the API Server through the internal domain name
fields.help_zh:
是否开启集群内部域名访问。 取值：
true：开启集群内部域名访问，节点侧组件（kubelet、kube-proxy）将通过集群内部域名访问API Server
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The internal DNS configuration for the cluster. Applicable to ACK managed clusters. The internal domain name is used by node-side system components such as kubelet and kube-proxy to access the API Server. When internal domain name access is not enabled, node-side system components access the API Server through the CLB IP address
fields.help_zh: 集群内部域名配置，适用于ACK托管集群。集群内部域名用于 kubelet、kube-proxy 等节点侧系统组件访问 API Server；未开启集群内部域名访问时，节点侧系统组件将通过 CLB IP 方式访问
fields.name: internal_dns_config

fields.help_en: The endpoint type
fields.help_zh: 端点类型
fields.name: endpoint_type

fields.help_en: The SLB instance associated with the endpoint
fields.help_zh: 端点关联的SLB实例
fields.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The cluster access load balancing configuration
fields.help_zh: 集群访问负载均衡配置
fields.name: load_balancers_config

parameters.help_en: The cluster connection configuration
parameters.help_zh: 集群连接配置
parameters.name: control_plane_endpoints_config

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the cluster to prevent accidental deletion through the console or API. Valid values:

`true`: Enables cluster deletion protection. The cluster cannot be deleted through the console or API.
`false`: Disables cluster deletion protection. The cluster can be deleted through the console or API.

Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh:
集群删除保护，防止通过控制台或API误删除集群。取值：

`true`：启用集群删除保护，将不能通过控制台或API删除集群。
`false`：不启用集群删除保护，则能通过控制台或API删除集群。

默认值：`false`
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the RAM Roles for Service Accounts (RRSA) feature. Only managed clusters support this parameter. Valid values:

`true`: Enabled.
`false`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用RRSA功能（只有托管版集群支持配置该参数）。取值：

`true`：启用。
`false`：禁用
parameters.name: enable_rrsa

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to rebind the cluster test domain name. Valid values:

`true`: Rebinds the cluster test domain name.
`false`: Does not rebind the cluster test domain name.

Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh:
重新绑定集群测试域名。取值：

`true`：重新绑定集群测试域名。
`false`：不重新绑定集群测试域名。

默认值：`false`
parameters.name: ingress_domain_rebinding

parameters.help_en: The SLB instance ID of the cluster to be modified
parameters.help_zh: 被修改集群的SLB实例ID
parameters.name: ingress_loadbalancer_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable instance deletion protection to prevent accidental deletion of nodes through the console or API. Valid values:

`true`: Nodes cannot be accidentally deleted through the console or API.
`false`: Nodes can be accidentally deleted through the console or API.

Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh:
实例删除保护，防止通过控制台或API误删除释放节点。取值：

`true`: 不能通过控制台或API误删除节点。
`false`：能通过控制台或API误删除节点。

默认值：`false`
parameters.name: instance_deletion_protection

fields.help_en:
The duration of the cluster maintenance window. 

Valid values: 1 to 24. 

Unit: hours.

Default value: 3
fields.help_zh:
维护时长。取值范围[1,24]，单位为小时。

默认值：3h
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the cluster maintenance window. Valid values:

`true`: enables the cluster maintenance window.
`false`: disables the cluster maintenance window.

Default value: `false`
fields.help_zh:
是否开启维护窗口。取值：
`true`：开启维护窗口。
`false`：不开启维护窗口。

默认值：`false`
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en: The start time of the cluster maintenance window. The value follows a standard time format in Golang. Example: 15:04:05Z
fields.help_zh: 维护起始时间。RFC3339标准格式
fields.name: maintenance_time

fields.help_en: Defines a maintenance window recurrence rule by using the RFC5545 recurrence rule. Currently, only FREQ=WEEKLY is supported, and you cannot specify COUNT or UNTIL
fields.help_zh: 使用RFC5545 Recurrence Rule语法定义的维护窗口循环规则，目前仅支持FREQ=WEEKLY，且不支持指定COUNT或UNTIL
fields.name: recurrence

fields.help_en:
The day of the week when maintenance is performed. Separate multiple days with commas (,). 

Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

Default value: `Thursday`
fields.help_zh:
维护周期，多个值用英文半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：{Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday}

默认值：`Thursday`
fields.name: weekly_period

parameters.help_en: The maintenance window configuration for the cluster. This feature takes effect only for ACK Pro clusters
parameters.help_zh: 集群维护窗口，该功能只在ACK托管集群Pro版中生效
parameters.name: maintenance_window

fields.help_en:
The cluster auto upgrade frequency. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712866.html.

Valid values:
patch: latest patch version.
stable: second-latest minor version.
rapid: latest minor version
fields.help_zh:
集群自动升级频次。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712866.html。

可取值：
patch：最新补丁版本。
stable：次新次要版本。
rapid：最新次要版本
fields.name: channel

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cluster auto upgrade.

true: Enables auto upgrade.

false: Disables auto upgrade
fields.help_zh:
是否开启集群自动升级。

true：开启自动升级。

false：不开启自动升级
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The cluster auto upgrade configuration
fields.help_zh: 集群自动升级
fields.name: cluster_auto_upgrade

parameters.help_en: The cluster automatic O&M policy
parameters.help_zh: 集群自动运维策略
parameters.name: operation_policy

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh: 集群资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The control plane security group ID.

If you have configured blocking rules in the security group, ensure that the security group rules allow the protocols and ports required by the cluster. For information about recommended security group rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353191.html.
For non-ACK dedicated clusters, the cluster control plane and installed managed components (such as terway-controlplane) briefly restart during the procedure. Perform this operation during off-peak hours. After the control plane security group is changed, the network interface controllers (NICs) used by the cluster control plane and installed managed components are automatically added to the new security group.
For ACK dedicated clusters, after the control plane security group is changed, newly scaled-out master nodes automatically use the new control plane security group. Existing control plane nodes are not affected
parameters.help_zh:
控制面安全组ID。

如您在安全组中配置了拦截规则，请确保安全组规则放行集群依赖的协议和端口，关于建议的安全组规则范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353191.html。
对于非ACK专有集群，变更过程中，集群控制面及已安装的托管组件（例如 terway-controlplane 等）将短暂重启，建议您在业务低峰期操作。变更控制面安全组后，集群控制面及已安装的托管组件使用的弹性网卡 ENI 将自动加入到新的安全组中。
对于 ACK 专有集群，变更控制面安全组后，新扩容的 Master 节点会自动应用新的控制面安全组，现有控制面节点不受影响
parameters.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable system event storage.


true: Enables system event storage.

false: Disables system event storage
fields.help_zh:
是否开启系统事件存储。


true：开启系统事件存储。

false：不开启系统事件存储
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The name of the LogProject used for system event storage
fields.help_zh: 系统事件存储的LogProject名称
fields.name: logging_project

parameters.help_en: The system event storage configuration

parameters.help_en:
The cluster time zone. See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354879.html.
After the time zone is changed, the cluster inspection configuration uses the new time zone settings.

For managed clusters, the cluster control plane and installed managed components (such as terway-controlplane) briefly restart during the change. Perform this operation during off-peak hours. After the time zone is changed, newly scaled-out nodes automatically use the new time zone settings. Existing nodes are not affected. You can use the node pool node reset feature to apply the new settings to existing nodes.

For dedicated clusters, after the time zone is changed, newly scaled-out nodes (including control plane nodes) automatically use the new time zone settings. Existing nodes (including control plane nodes) are not affected. You can use the node pool node reset feature to apply the new settings to existing nodes. For control plane nodes, scale out and then scale in to apply the new settings to all control plane nodes
parameters.help_zh:
集群时区。请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354879.html。
变更时区后，集群巡检配置将采用新的时区设置。

对于托管类集群，变更过程中，集群控制面及已安装的托管组件（例如 terway-controlplane 等）将短暂重启，建议您在业务低峰期操作。变更时区后，新扩容的节点会自动应用新的时区设置，现有节点不受影响，您可以通过节点池节点重置功能使现有节点生效。

对于专有集群，变更时区后，新扩容的节点（包括控制面节点）会自动应用新的时区设置，现有节点（包括控制面节点）不受影响，您可以通过节点池节点重置功能使现有节点生效。对于控制面节点，您需要通过扩容后再缩容的方式使全量控制面节点生效
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitches for the cluster control plane. For dedicated clusters, the change applies to newly scaled-out control plane nodes. When changing control plane vSwitches for managed clusters, note the following:
This parameter performs a full overwrite. Specify the complete list of target vSwitches.
Control plane components briefly restart during the change. Proceed with caution.
Ensure that all security groups of the cluster (including the control plane security group, security groups of all node pools, and security groups used by the container network) allow inbound and outbound traffic for the IP CIDR blocks of the new vSwitches to prevent nodes and containers from losing connectivity to the API server.
If the new control plane vSwitches have ACL rules configured, ensure that the ACL rules allow communication with the CIDR blocks of cluster nodes and the container network
parameters.help_zh:
集群控制面虚拟交换机。专有集群变更后，将作用于新扩容的控制面节点。托管类集群变更控制面虚拟交换机，请注意以下事项：
该参数为覆盖更新，需完全指定目标交换机列表。
变更过程控制面组件会短暂重启，请谨慎操作。
请确保集群所有安全组（包括控制面安全组、所有节点池的安全组、容器网络使用的安全组）的出入方向已放行新的虚拟交换机的 IP 网段，避免节点与容器无法连接 API server。
如新的控制面交换机配置了 ACL 规则，请确保该 ACL 规则已经放行其与集群节点、容器网络等 IP 网段的通信
